annotations.title: Adjacent parcels, owners and the combined site

description:
The parcels adjacent to one parcel and who owns each — the first question
    of a site assembly. Returns each neighbour with its area, land use,
    constraints and registered proprietor, plus a `combined` block: total area
    in m² and hectares, the number of distinct owners, how many neighbours
    already share the subject's proprietor (the parcels needing no second
    negotiation), how many have no linked owner, and every constraint present
    across the whole assembly.

    Address the subject by `parcel_id`, `inspire_id`, `title_number` or
    `uprn`. Adjacency means a boundary intersecting the subject's buffered by
    `tolerance_m` (0.5 m default) — registered boundaries rarely share an
    exact edge, so a strict touch finds almost nothing. Widen `ring_m` to look
    further than immediate neighbours.

    A neighbour with no owner is one no registered title has been linked to,
    NOT one nobody owns — say which when you report it.
    UK only. Costs 10 credits (10p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: land_assembly
